name: pinna
description: Self-hosted visual feedback for websites: reviewers pin comments on a staging site, the team answers and marks them done. Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2 and Vue.
author: Michel Dimitri

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply pinna --remote && node scripts/build.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:secrets: wrangler d1 migrations apply pinna --remote && node scripts/build.mjs && wrangler deploy --secrets-file .deploy-secrets.env
